purpose: Teach: フェミニスト/思慮/恒常/親日/親睦/大局/同紙/領主

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、フェミニスト視点を取り入れた職場を作れ
lines.en: Build a workplace that incorporates feminist perspectives.
lines.style: Clear directive. Measured pace. Authoritative but not unkind. Expects compliance without needing to repeat himself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に思慮ある対応を求めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll make sure our staff approach things with care and thought.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Steady, attentive tone. Not rushing — giving weight to each part of what was asked. Formal register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、品質の恒常的な向上を目指せ
lines.en: We need to commit to continuous improvement in our quality standards.
lines.style: Statement of principle. Deliberate, unrushed delivery. Slight emphasis on 'continuous'—it's non-negotiable. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。親日的な海外顧客を大切にします
lines.en: Yes. We'll make sure to value and care for our international clients, especially those who support Japan.
lines.style: Earnest commitment. Slightly formal register. Even pace, no hesitation. Shows he understands the fuller intent behind the instruction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員親睦会を年に二回開け
lines.en: Hold staff social gatherings twice a year.
lines.style: Directive stated plainly. No elaboration needed. Brief, confident. The tone of someone who knows this will be done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。大局的な経営判断を心がけます
lines.en: Understood. I'll keep in mind the bigger picture when making management decisions.
lines.style: Formal confirmation. Thoughtful cadence. Shows he's absorbing the principle, not just the task. Respectful without sounding strained.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、同紙の経済記事を朝礼で共有しろ
lines.en: Make sure we share the economic articles from that newspaper during morning briefings.
lines.style: Clear instruction. Specific. Measured delivery. Not rushed, but expects efficient execution of the directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。領主のような独裁経営は致しません
lines.en: Yes. I won't run this company like a feudal lord. Our approach will be collaborative, not dictatorial.
lines.style: Final confirmation with subtle reassurance. Slight warmth under the formality—he's understood the philosophy, not just the orders. Calm, measured close.
